checks.name: Command has create slip endpoint
checks.evidence: Looks for POST route containing slips.
checks.recommendation: Add POST /api/command/slips so Send to Command creates real backend slips.

checks.name: Frontend Command reads backend slips
checks.recommendation: Command page should load slips from backend and only fallback to preview.

checks.name: Send to Command bridge exists
checks.recommendation: Create shared bridge used by all Send to Command buttons.

checks.name: No localStorage-only Command sends left
checks.recommendation: Old preview localStorage can remain as fallback, but every Send to Command button should also call backend bridge.

checks.name: Frontend signup calls backend
checks.evidence: Looks for frontend register/signup API call.
checks.recommendation: Signup form must POST to backend, not only navigate.

checks.name: Email provider code/config present
checks.recommendation: Wire transactional email provider for verification, welcome, forgot password and invites.

checks.name: Email verification flow present
checks.recommendation: Signup should send verification email and block/limit unverified accounts.

checks.name: Forgot password email flow present
checks.recommendation: Forgot password should generate token, email link, and reset password safely.

checks.name: Team invite email flow present
checks.evidence: Looks for team/worker invite email code.
checks.recommendation: Adding staff should send an invite email automatically.

checks.name: Credentials/cookies used from frontend
checks.recommendation: Frontend API calls need credentials for secure-cookie auth.

checks.name: Backend CORS allows credentials
checks.recommendation: Backend CORS must allow credentials from www.churvox.com.

checks.name: Secure cookie settings present
checks.recommendation: Production cookies should be httpOnly, secure, SameSite=None.

checks.name: Stripe checkout/backend route present
checks.recommendation: Plan checkout should be backend-created and persist selected plan after success.

checks.name: Frontend plans/checkout present
checks.recommendation: Plans page should create checkout session and show current plan.

checks.name: Important buttons have handlers
checks.recommendation: Review suspicious buttons so no important button is visual-only.

checks.name: Frontend API calls inventory found
checks.recommendation: Every API call should map to a backend route and handle loading/error states.

checks.name: Preview/demo/localStorage usage reviewed
checks.recommendation: Keep fallback storage only where intentional; remove fake demo data from launch-critical flows.
